title: Hosted API geo-pin operator and evidence export workflow
creator: Marisol Chen
description: Problem: Several enterprise customers require that all inference requests and stored artifacts for a given tenant be constrained to a specific geographic region and that we can produce machine-readable evidence bundles proving controls were enforced. Current hosted behaviour routes by latency and capacity and lacks an operator-friendly way to pin tenants at a per-API-key or per-tenant granularity, and evidence exports are ad-hoc CSVs requiring manual stitching.
goals: 1) Expose a first-class "geo-pin operator" concept in Hosted API enabling operators and account owners to pin or unpin tenants to a set of allowed regions. 2) Produce consistent, auditable evidence bundles that show routing decisions, retention settings, and exportable policy attestations for a selected time window. 3) Provide UI and API controls for bulk operations and rollback, and an automated export endpoint for compliance teams.
non_goals: We will not in this iteration implement cross-region replication or enforce residency for customer-managed private deployments. This ticket is focused on hosted API tenant-routing policies and evidence generation only.
success_metrics: All new enterprise tenants can be geo-pinned via UI or API (target: 100% within release)
Evidence bundle generation completes within 2 minutes for 30-day window (metric measured in runtime)
Reduction in compliance ticket cycle time (request -> delivered evidence) by 60% for customers using geo-pin
< 1 day of manual ops work per evidence export for customer support
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /v1/tenants/:id/geo-pin accepts a list of allowed regions and returns 202 with an operation id
UI: Tenant Settings contains a 'Region pinning' panel with current pin state, history, and bulk unpin action
Routing: All requests from a pinned tenant are routed only to allowed regions; any fallback is logged as a policy violation event

Evidence: GET /v1/tenants/:id/evidence?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD returns an encrypted artifact containing routing logs, policy configuration snapshot, and retention settings in machine-readable JSON
Audit: Evidence bundle includes sha256 checksums and a signed manifest for legal acceptance
Rollback: Operator can schedule an unpin which becomes active after a configured grace window and is recorded in the audit trail
api_spec_summary:
Endpoints (summary):
- POST /v1/tenants/:id/geo-pin { allowed_regions: ["us-west-2","eu-central-1"], reason: string } -> 202 (operation_id)
- GET /v1/operations/:op_id -> {status: enum, details: string}
- GET /v1/tenants/:id/evidence?start=&end=&format={json,zip} -> 200 (application/json or application/zip)
- POST /v1/tenants/:id/geo-pin/bulk-unpin { scheduled_at: iso8601 } -> 202
Notes: All endpoints require admin role; supports pagination and S3-backed artifact retrieval for large windows.
ux_notes: Design intent: keep the region pin UX minimal for non-expert operators. The panel shows current pin, last modified, reason, and a timeline of pin changes. Confirmations must include a 'compliance acknowledgement' checkbox and surface the effective time windows. Provide a small 'preview' giving percent of traffic currently served from pinned regions (derived from 24h routing sample). Bulk operations live behind a feature flag for the first rollout.
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (canary): API + minimal UI behind feature flag; internal tenants only; monitor policy-violation events
Stage 2 (beta): Invite 3 compliance customers; add evidence export; collect feedback on manifest format
Stage 3 (public): Enable in Console for all enterprise accounts; add bulk unpin flow and scheduled rollback
Stage 4: Post-release: iterate on export schema and add automated attestation signing via customer KMS (follow-up ticket)
migration_plan: For existing tenants with region preferences inferred from billing or contracts, provide a one-time migration tool that suggests pinning based on historical traffic patterns. Migration requires operator approval recorded in the audit log. We'll coordinate with Account Services to notify customers before auto-suggested pinning.
metrics_and_alerting: Meter 'policy.violation.count' when a request from a pinned tenant is served outside allowed regions (critical alert if > 1/min for 15m)
Gauge 'evidence.export.latency' for SLAs (SLO target: 95% under 2 minutes for 30-day window)
SLO: Evidence export availability 99.9% per month
open_risks: Edge case: model fallback when pinned model variant isn't available in allowed region — must never violate pinning; fallback should fail gracefully and surface to customer
Operational: large evidence exports (multi-GB) may require signed URLs and async retrieval; cost and retention of artifacts must be accounted for
Legal: customers may request cryptographic proof of residency; scope for HSM/KMS integration is deferred and will require additional security review
